'''Donny Versiga''' is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] with the image on two cards: [[Death Star: Docking Control Room 327 (Virtual Set 23)|•Death Star: Docking Control Room 327]] and [[Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach (ALT)|•Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach (ALT)]].<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref><ref name="pcimages">Players Committee card images at res.starwarsccg.org (Virtual Sets 0–27, Virtual Premium and alternate images at 745 × 1039; Virtual Blocks 1–9 and Virtual Shields at 350 × 490), the source the card label data was read from. Each card's article shows its image.</ref> The credit on •Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach (ALT) ([[Virtual Set 0]]) also names [[Card Credits#Robin Luera|Robin Luera]]. The credited cards were printed in [[Virtual Set 0]] (2014) and [[Virtual Set 23]] (2024), so the credited cards span 2014–2024. Donny Versiga is listed on [[Card Credits#Donny Versiga|Card Credits]].
